Agent: No issues, annual service — perfect. What’s the postcode?
User: NE4 5AB
Agent: Postcode N-E-4-5-A-B — got it. What’s the house number or property name?
User: 10
Agent: Number 10 — right. And the street name?
User: Green Rd
Agent: Green Rd — brilliant. So that's 10 Green Rd, postcode N-E-4-5-A-B. Is that right?
User: Yes, that's right
Agent: I’m just checking the next slots now.
Agent: I’ve got today after 5, or tomorrow at half eleven. Which suits?
User: Tomorrow works
Agent: Tomorrow works — perfect. Let me check the best slot.
Agent: I’ve got tomorrow at half eleven, or tomorrow after half twelve. Which suits?
User: Yes, book it
Agent: Half eleven tomorrow — lovely.Right, Linda — I’ve got 10 Green Rd, postcode N-E-4-5-A-B, tomorrow at half eleven. Sound okay?
User: No, that's all thanks. Bye!
